title: Flooded-well hold and testing plan
summary: Stop drinking-water use from a well affected by floodwater until appropriate inspection, disinfection, testing, and local clearance are completed.
materials: clean caps or lids for “Flooded-well hold and testing plan”
labels and marker for “Flooded-well hold and testing plan”
steps: Label the source as not for drinking, protect users from accidental collection, arrange an alternative safe supply, and record all official testing and clearance.
